items.title: pinky
items.description: Let AI agents use your phone, with you in the loop.
items.summary: Pinky is a free and open-source tool that allows AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to operate real Android and iOS devices over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux, enforcing human approvals for risky actions like payments while hiding sensitive apps and fields by default. On Android, USB debugging must be turned on, and the phone must accept the computer's key or pair over Wi-Fi. For iOS, an iPhone requires a helper app, WebDriverAgent, built and installed once from Xcode with an Apple ID. Pinky supports connections via USB, Wi-Fi, and Tailscale. The software is pre-alpha and does not support iOS 17.3 and earlier.

items.title: vork
items.description: Headless 3D and VFX engine for agents. Research preview.
items.summary: Vork is a headless 3D and visual-effects engine designed for agents, allowing them to write scenes as code, render them on the GPU, and revise the code based on the results. It is written in Rust and Slang, with GPU rendering through Vulkan and Metal. The engine is currently in research preview and is source-available and free. The repository reports 802 stars and a velocity of 430 stars per day, indicating early interest in tools built specifically for agent-driven visual production. The engine provides geometry, ray queries, and GPU execution, enabling agents to define materials, cameras, light propagation, simulation, and compositing. It is not yet a ready-made production tool, but it points to a different way of using agents for visual work.

items.title: aida-64-extreme
items.description: Aida 64 Extreme 2026: Complete Standalone Desktop Setup with Full Feature Configuration
items.summary: AIDA64 Extreme 2026 is a comprehensive system information tool that provides detailed hardware and software diagnostics, benchmarks, and real-time sensor monitoring. The latest version, v8.40, was released on September 15, 2026, and is available in both EXE and ZIP package formats. The EXE package is 59.7 MB, and the ZIP package is 62.1 MB. The tool is compatible with all current 64-bit Microsoft Windows operating systems, including Windows 11 and Windows Server 2022. It offers a 30-day trial before requiring purchase.

items.title: aion-2-trainer-tool
items.description: Aion 2 AI Prompt Engineering Toolkit - Standalone Desktop Trainer Setup
items.summary: The Aion 2 Trainer Tool, also known as aion-2-trainer-tool, is an AI Prompt Engineering Toolkit for Aion 2, available as a standalone desktop trainer setup. It is hosted on GitHub under the repository Arda313131882/aion-2-trainer-tool and is licensed under MIT, making it free for both personal and commercial use. The tool was last updated on November 10, 2026, and was indexed on SkillStore on November 8, 2026. It is described as a utility automation system for desktop developer tools, specifically for Aion 2 game-related applications.

items.title: poki
items.description: Let AI agents operate a real iPhone. Local MCP server and agent, no jailbreak, no extra hardware.
items.summary: Poki is an open-source project that allows AI agents to operate a real iPhone by running a local MCP server. It does not require jailbreaking the iPhone or using any extra hardware. The project is still early, with under 450 stars and two days old, and it needs a Mac to run. It connects to AI agents like Claude Code or Codex to perform tasks such as tapping, swiping, and typing on the iPhone. The project has gained 900+ stars on GitHub in under a week and is free and open source under the AGPL-3.0 license.

items.title: solo-to-team-skills

items.summary: To build strong AI teams, it is essential to combine technical skills with human capabilities that technology can't replicate. According to Deloitte, high-performing teams excel due to human capabilities like adaptability, connected teaming, and critical thinking. The LinkedIn content emphasizes the importance of context, reusable instructions, human checkpoints, testing and verification, and security guardrails. Harvard Business Impact highlights the need for AI literacy and the complementary human strengths of adaptability, judgment, and creativity that make the difference in reaching organizational goals.

items.title: hermes-voice
items.description: Talk to a Hermes Agent profile through Home Assistant Assist
items.summary: The sources indicate that Hermes Agent can be integrated with Home Assistant to function as a native conversation agent, facilitating a full voice loop from wake word to speech-to-text (STT) through Home Assistant, processing via Hermes, and then text-to-speech (TTS) back to the speaker. This integration allows Hermes to communicate with Home Assistant, enabling users to select Hermes as a preferred conversation agent in Home Assistant settings. The TTS provider is configurable, with examples using ElevenLabs, and STT runs through Home Assistant's existing pipeline. The sources do not provide a definitive answer regarding specific details beyond this general functionality.

items.title: phoneuse
items.description: See and operate an unmodified iPhone from a Linux PC: AirPlay mirror in, Bluetooth HID mouse/keyboard out, plus a CLI and skill for agents.
items.summary: Phone Use mirrors a real iPhone to Linux over AirPlay, enabling operation via Bluetooth mouse and keyboard. It includes an unmodified iPhone without jailbreak or app, recipes for every interaction, an agent skill and MCP server, and a CLI for tap, type, swipe, open, and back commands. The project is MIT licensed and works with Claude Code. The agent operates the real phone when pointed at it. The sources do not provide specific dates or versions for these features.

items.title: devvm
items.description: One VM for every project. An isolated sandbox with your project’s toolchain, ready for you or a coding agent to start coding
items.summary: Devvm creates an isolated virtual machine for each project folder, providing a separate guest kernel and a default network allowlist. It runs a full Linux VM for each project, using Lima on macOS or Linux, and defaults new VMs to an allowlist network tier. The VM mounts only the project folder, keeping secrets on the host while running coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and opencode inside the VM. The VM is free and open source under the MIT license, running on macOS and Linux, on either arm64 or x86_64 architecture.

items.title: yogurt
items.description: Private AI meeting notes. Free and open source.
items.summary: Yogurt is a free, open-source app that generates private AI meeting notes. It records calls locally without adding a bot to the meeting, and produces a summary with the plan, next steps by person, and personal reminders. It runs on macOS 14.4+ (Apple Silicon), Windows 10 2004+ (x64), and Ubuntu 22.04+ (x64 AppImage), requiring 8 GB of memory. The project is MIT licensed and made by Frigade.

items.title: dsh-game-studio
items.description: Describe a small game in one sentence, play it in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, swap in AI art, and publish to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare in one click.
items.summary: The sources describe dsh-game-studio as a local-first TypeScript plugin for generating and packaging small browser games, which can be built, tested, and packaged into a completely playable offline HTML game using the Deep Sea Carniss sidebar. The process involves submitting a single sentence prompt to the agent, which then uses a default 2D top-own starter template to create the game. The final game is highly portable and capable of running offline. The DeepSeek Harness framework, which dsh-game-studio utilizes, is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI, allowing for rapid iteration and compatibility-breaking changes.

items.title: youtube-ai-video-editing-system

items.summary: The sources indicate that the YouTube-AI-Video-Editing-System project on GitHub includes an Eyeline teleprompter, editing agents, JSON-driven animation, and motion graphics workflow. The system connects scripts, recorded takes, source clips, and designed visuals, keeping decisions in readable Markdown and JSON. The project also features a design workflow with restyled HTML reference boards and an animated board library for motion graphics. The sources do not provide specific details about the current status or updates beyond the GitHub repository's structure and features.

items.title: ai-app-builder-open
items.description: Open-source AI app builder for full-stack Next.js apps with hosting and auth
items.summary: The ai-app-builder-open is an open-source AI app builder for full-stack Next.js apps, offering features like hosting, sandbox, database, and authentication. It supports various authentication providers such as Supabase Auth, Better Auth, Clerk, and Auth0, and payment providers like Stripe. The builder runs on Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS 4, and it provides a live preview, code editor, and one-click hosting. It is self-hosted and offers a free version, positioning itself as a no-code alternative to Lovable, Bolt, and Replit.

items.title: ste80-humanizer
items.description: STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared.
items.summary: The STE80 Humanizer is an agent skill that rewrites AI-generated text to remove common 'AI tells' and restructure sentences toward ASD-STE100, the Simplified Technical English standard used in aircraft maintenance manuals. It combines Wikipedia's 26-pattern 'Signs of AI writing' catalog with Andrej Karpathy's idea of writing '80% of the way to ASD-STE100' for clearer, more human-sounding prose. The skill can be installed via `npx skills add Dodaios/ste80-humanizer` for use with various agents. ASD-STE100 is a controlled language from 1980s aerospace maintenance manuals, built for mechanics whose first language isn't English, with rules like 20 words per instruction, one idea per sentence, active voice, and about 900 approved words. Karpathy suggested asking an LLM to explain things '80% of the way to ASD-STE100' because the full spec is too stringent for natural prose but makes output more readable.

items.title: airpointer
items.summary: The airpointer is an ambient air quality monitoring station that offers a choice of analysis modules for monitoring airborne pollutants such as SO2, NO2/NOX, CO, O3, and PM, approved by the EU, WHO, US-EPA, and other organizations. It is suitable for fenceline monitoring, mobile applications, and can be used in tight spaces. The airpointer can measure up to two different ambient air gases, is air-conditioned, and can operate in temperatures ranging from -20 °C to +42 °C. It features an internal data management system and an online platform for easy data viewing. The airpointer is available in 2D and 4D versions, with the 4D version offering a choice of four modules.

items.title: auto-ontology-mcp
items.description: NVIDIA Auto Ontology's semantic layer and a personal knowledge base as an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients. No LLM API key needed.
items.summary: The sources describe the Auto-Ontology MCP server as a tool that allows any MCP-capable agent to ask questions about data in natural language and inspect the semantic layer behind the answers. It is an HTTP client of the public Auto-Ontology API, holding no database credentials, model configuration, or its own credentials. The server can be installed with `uvx`, and clients connect to it without needing credentials. The server provides read-only tools to MCP clients, and users sign in through Auto-Ontology with their permissions governing each call. Ports 3001 and 3002 should be kept on a private network. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to the specific question about the server's connection to Claude, but they do mention that it can be used with various clients including Cursor and Claw Desktop.

items.title: turkish-anti-ai-skill
items.description: Türkçe metinlerdeki yapay zeka izlerini (AI slop, translationese, çeviri kokan cümle mimarisi ve TDK hatalarını) temizleyen Agent Skill ve Humanizer paketi.
items.summary: The turkish-anti-ai-skill is an open-source Agent Skill and Humanizer package designed by Yüce Zerey to remove AI slop, translationese, and TDK errors from Turkish texts. It features a 3-layer architecture to handle composition templates, syntax/morphology, and TDK punctuation rules, and includes a 60+ Slop Dictionary & Phonetic Suffixes to target AI clichés and apply correct Turkish phonetic suffix rules. The skill also has an Anti-Fabrication Lock to ensure factual fidelity and a Deterministic CLI Detector to scan for AI-slop density, TDK mistakes, and sentence burstiness.

items.title: maxagent
items.description: Experience for AI agents: hooks that make Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and OpenClaw recall and record what worked, plus maxagent-bridge for your own Chrome.
items.summary: The sources indicate that the maxagent Experience for AI agents includes hooks that make Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and OpenClaw recall and record what worked. Specifically, the sources highlight that Claude Code, using the Opus 5.5 model, delivered the best experience with almost all features working perfectly and a well-thought-out editor layout. Codex, developed with the Luna 6 model, built most basic features but had an unappealing interface. Additionally, the sources mention that claude-mem automatically records every Claude Code session and claude-code-hooks-mastery provides a guide to mastering Claude Code’s Hooks mechanism. There is no mention of a maxagent-bridge for Chrome in the provided sources.

items.title: image-to-sculpt
items.description: Turn one image of anything into a 3D sculpt measured against that image: registered views, map-fitting passes, Blender replay and timelapse. A skill for coding agents.
items.summary: The GitHub repository "image-to-sculpt" by gokayfem turns a single image into a 3D sculpt that matches the image's normals, outline, and depth. It uses coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini to fit a watertight sculpt to the image, complete unseen sides from generated views, and records every step for Blender to replay as a timelapse. The process includes registering every view, fitting recorded map-passes, cutting and smoothing open gaps, and checking the map sheet and metrics per view. The final output includes a timelapse ending in a 360° turn, a report, and a review page. The YouTube tutorial by What Make Art shows how to use Autodesk Flow Studio Image to 3D to generate a 3D model from an image and refine it in Blender.

items.title: best-agent-memory-mcp

Cognee is an open-source agent memory platform that allows LLM agents to capture context and recall it across sessions. Basic Memory is an open-source AI memory and knowledge base that provides a one-place solution for notes, decisions, and workflows for teams and AI tools. Mem0 is an AI memory layer that enables agents and apps to learn from past interactions to enhance intelligence and personalization. The sources do not provide a comprehensive ranking or comparison of these platforms.

items.title: sakutto
items.description: A browser extension for easy on-device translation with a local LLM (PLaMo). Private, free, no server needed.
items.summary: Sakutto is a Chrome extension for on-device translation using a local LLM (PLaMo). It translates entire web pages with a language model running inside the browser, requiring no account, upload, or server. The model file is 547 MB and it runs on 4 CPU cores through WebAssembly. The launch tweet drew 5,858 likes in a day, and the model file has passed 20,000 downloads. The engine is PLaMo 3 Translate 0.8B from Preferred Networks, trained with Japan's national lab NICT. The extension is free and private, with no server needed.

It supports inputs like Twitter long articles, webpages, and local Markdown files, and videos from platforms like Douyin, YouTube, and Bilibili. The tool outputs magazine-style long images, small red book 3:4 image posts, public platform layouts, AI-narrated vertical videos, original text layouts, translations, whiteboard arguments, and black-and-white comics. It has 21 themes and automatically checks the quality of each output. It requires Node.js 22 and Chrome.

items.title: gpt-anime-denoise
items.description: 去除 GPT 生图在二次元 / 番剧图里的风味噪点（包括但不限于鱼鳞状纹理、碎片化细节、碎片化阴影），不重画画面 · Removes the GPT-flavoured noise (fish-scale texture, fragmented detail and shading) from anime images
items.summary: The sources indicate that GPT-generated images, especially those in anime style, often exhibit "noise" such as fish-scale texture, fragmented details, and shading. The sources suggest that GPT-Image 2.6 has improved in reducing these noise elements, but the issue persists, with potential causes including uneven overlap in kernel size and stride mismatches, interference from latent space texture patterns, multiple rounds of generation/editing amplifying noise, and training data containing network image noise. To mitigate these issues, the sources recommend specifying clean prompts and using image repair techniques to focus on local cleaning rather than full repainting.

items.title: phonebox

items.title: headless
items.description: Agent skill that sets up a headless Mac, Linux or Windows machine over SSH, step by step, without ever seeing the admin password.
items.summary: To set up a headless SSH agent without seeing the admin password, you can use 1Password. First, configure the SSH agent by adding `Host IdentityAgent ~/.config/1Password/ssh/agent.sock` to your SSH config. Then, create the directory `~/.config/1Password/` and the file `~/.config/1Password/settings.json` with the content `{ "app.developer.sshAgent": true }`. Install the 1Password Client with `sudo apt install 1password` and sign in using `op signin`. However, the 1Password Community notes that you will need the 1Password Client installed with a GUI to manage the SSH-Agent.

items.title: blender-unreal-asset-bridge
items.description: An AI-assisted asset bridge from Blender to Unreal Engine — batch-export static and skeletal meshes, animations, collisions, sockets and cameras into a UE-ready folder tree, rebuild everything with generated import scripts, and let the built-in AI assistant take the routine off your hands on Windows. · blender · unreal engine · blender addon
items.summary: The Blender-Unreal-Asset-Bridge add-on allows export of static and skeletal meshes, animations, Alembic files, collisions/sockets, splines, cameras, and sequencer content from Blender to Unreal Engine, compatible from Blender 2.8 to the latest version and works with Unreal Engine 4 and 5. It enables batch export of all assets simultaneously, organizing them into a proper tree structure in line with the Unreal Engine pipeline. The add-on also generates import scripts to directly import assets into Unreal Engine and includes an error checker to identify and prevent potential problems. The add-on is open-source and can be easily adapted to any production.

items.title: mindact-agent
items.description: MindAct: Community-Driven AI Agent for Claude, Obsidian, and RAG Knowledge Graphs
items.summary: MindAct is a community-driven AI agent released under the MIT License, allowing users to freely use, modify, and share it. It is designed to work with tools like Obsidian and RAG Knowledge Graphs, aiming to make local, AI-driven knowledge management accessible. The agent can be customized for personal or team use, and it includes commands like /start, /help, and /connect to manage and link to an Obsidian vault. It leverages the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and plugins like Smart Connections to provide a high-fidelity RAG pipeline, enabling advanced knowledge graph and second brain functionalities for AI agents.

The fabric ontology is a component that includes 16 entity types and their relationships, all sitting on top of the fabric lakehouse. Fabric data agents can interact with these items, including the ontology, to understand business contacts and company operations. A Fabric data agent supports up to five data sources, including lakehouses, warehouses, KQL databases, Power BI semantic models, ontologies, and Microsoft Graph. To create a Fabric data agent, you need a paid F2 or higher Fabric capacity, or a Power BI Premium per capacity (P1 or higher) capacity with Microsoft Fabric enabled.

items.summary: Dream Textures is a free, open-source Blender add-on that utilizes Stable Diffusion to generate seamless textures and projected materials directly within Blender. It is best suited for Blender artists who want free, in-context texture generation without leaving the software. Dream Textures can create complete PBR map sets from text prompts, single images, or directly onto 3D models, replacing hours of manual material work for game-ready and rendered assets. It is highlighted as the best free Blender add-on for texture generation in 2026.
